plugins.name: alpaca-algo-plus-data

plugins.name: markov-regime-features
plugins.description: Debugging and implementing dynamic Markov regime features in RL observations. Triggers: (1) Markov features appear constant in observation heatmaps, (2) uniform priors [0.33, 0.34, 0.33] instead of actual regime probabilities, (3) InferenceObservationBuilder not updating states, (4) HMM regime detection not reflecting market conditions

plugins.name: selection-progress-reporting
plugins.description: Progress reporting for universe selection phases. Trigger when: (1) selection appears to stall/hang, (2) no output after data fetching, (3) need visibility into hard filter or scoring phases.

plugins.name: gpu-correlation-caching

plugins.name: crypto-hard-filter-simplification

plugins.name: testing-benchmarking-infrastructure

Verified on Python 3.10/3.11 trading system with pytest 8.4.

plugins.name: multi-agent-integration
plugins.description: Integrate Claude agents into training and live trading (v3.0). Trigger when: (1) setting up multi-agent training, (2) adding agent consultation to live trading, (3) configuring orchestrator, (4) understanding agent roles and safety mechanisms.
plugins.author: Claude Code

plugins.name: empirical-config-builder
plugins.description: Derive selection thresholds from market data instead of hardcoding. Trigger when: (1) reviewing hardcoded parameters, (2) volume/price thresholds seem arbitrary, (3) selection returns too many/few candidates, (4) adapting to market conditions.

plugins.name: colab-notebook-development

plugins.name: crypto-pair-fee-optimization

plugins.name: backtest-capital-accounting

plugins.name: codebase-consolidation-pattern
plugins.description: Reorganize scattered modules into subpackages while maintaining backwards compatibility. Trigger when: (1) too many root-level files, (2) need to group related functionality, (3) cleaning up codebase structure without breaking imports.

plugins.name: training-archive-gating
plugins.description: Mandatory training archive with model gating (APPROVED/REVIEW/DROP). Trigger when: (1) training run completes, (2) need to decide which models to deploy, (3) want historical training reference, (4) need checkpoint recommendations for overfitting.

plugins.name: branch-integration-workflow

plugins.name: symbol-selection-asset-filters

plugins.name: symbol-selection-statistical
plugins.description: Statistical symbol selection for algorithmic trading. plugins.name: crypto-database-population

plugins.name: trading-gates-pattern-filter

plugins.name: reward-function-hold-bias

plugins.name: drawdown-guardrails-pattern

plugins.name: dashboard-pnl-visualization

plugins.name: persistence-layer-audit

plugins.name: network-architecture-sizing

plugins.name: parallel-universe-selection
